title: Mathematics for Elementary School Teachers II
description: Probability, including combinations and permutations. Basic algebra and functions. Basic geometry; measurement topics, including length, area and volume; compass and straight-edge constructions. Problem solving is emphasized throughout.
notes: Credit will be granted for only one of MATH 162, MATH 160, MATH 160B.
Not open for credit to students with more than 3.0 units of credit in MATH courses numbered 100 or higher (excluding MATH 120) without prior permission of the department.
Intended for prospective Elementary Education students only.
